title: Olympic Gold Medals Are Mostly Silver
hook: An Olympic gold medal has only 6 g of gold in it
summary: An Olympic gold medal is silver coated with 6 g of gold.

text: Every athlete's dream: an Olympic gold medal.
By the rules, a gold medal is at least 92.5% silver.
Then it's coated with 6 g of gold.

panels.mean: how much gold goes into a gold medal

panels.text: It's a gold medal but it's silver inside?

text: Silver medals are made of 92.5% silver too.
So going by materials alone, a gold medal
is a silver medal with a layer of gold on top.

panels.text: Still, a gold medal's a gold medal
